top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Not Obtained (26 TAC §745.253)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was found that the operation has not entered or provided licensing with liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a swing.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to notify Licensing of a change in director.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.
